verdict: PASS for look with 1 major + 5 minor; no blockers. Reproducible (state JSON byte-identical).

findings.owner: scene D (C to confirm dye near cylinder at t=0)
findings.what: Frame-0 mismatch at cylinder base: frame0.png shows a bright magenta ring hugging the cylinder base; ck002 f0 has only a small magenta blob at the stagnation point. The ring builds up in the render by ~f24-60, so it visibly appears during the first ~2 s (frame 0 is not 'kept').
findings.fix: D: confirm whether the ring is dye (sheet z=0.013) or a contact-line/meniscus highlight in frame0; if dye, C checks why the Lagrangian release (t_rel -3.85 s) has not wrapped the centre streak around the cylinder by t=0 (source radius/boundary-layer seeding); if look, D adds it as a declared static base-meniscus element.

findings.what: Streak tips at the cylinder are crisp in ck002, soft/feathered (~10-20 px fade) in frame0. Streak ROI MAD 5.2 DN (whole frame 2.29 DN; ref f0 vs frame0 6.09 DN for scale).
findings.fix: Optional: alpha feather of the dye front over <=1 mm (look only, declared). Physics front position unchanged.

findings.what: post.py grain is a frozen pattern: high-pass temporal std on the static table 0.007 DN vs reference 0.40 DN; residual correlation f10/f200 0.999 vs ref 0.34. Reads as a dirty-lens texture in a locked-off shot (subtle at sigma 1.6).

Water-surface micro-ripple motion barely visible: high-pass temporal std in dye-free water 0.26 DN vs ref 1.15 DN (ref value inflated by AI shimmer + camera drift). Wall highlights move; open water looks static.
findings.fix: Optional: raise water_ripple_strength 0.025 -> ~0.04 or add slow second octave; keep translation at U (declared look).

findings.what: Static upstream streaks flicker slightly: mean |dI/dframe| 0.52 DN on streak pixels (raw 0.53, so render noise not post) vs ref 0.17; per-frame mean V on streaks 161.2-164.1 (std 0.79). Not visible at 8-bit in playback.
findings.fix: Final render: more samples / denoiser with fixed seed; no change needed for preview.

findings.what: Wake dye crisper and more saturated than reference: S 115.6 vs 88.3, V 158 vs 128, low-sat fraction 0.15 vs 0.50, off-palette hue 0.04 vs 0.28 (f240). No muddy/white blending (bright-white fraction 0.000 vs 0.004). Colour groups balanced (Y/C/M 0.32/0.32/0.32) vs ref yellow-dominant 0.44/0.16/0.12. This follows the corrected physics (Sc~1000, conserved colour budget) and is NOT a defect; the ref's halo/mixing is the AI's non-conserved colour budget.
findings.fix: none (optional <=0.3 mm soft halo if lead wants closer look).

passes.upstream_streak_match_frame0: vertical FWHM at full-res columns 560/640/720: ck002 7-10 px vs frame0 8-11 px (~10% narrower), saturation within +-10/255, V +0..+20 brighter; hues identical (19-21, 98-99, 165-166). evidence visual_review/ck002_streak_widths.json
passes.camera_stability: max phase-correlation shift vs f0 over f0-240: 0.24 px (half-res) - locked; ref drift up to 5.9 px is an AI defect not to imitate
passes.occlusion: cylinder occludes dye correctly at all inspected frames (0,24,60,120,240); dye stays inside channel walls; needles visible over streaks
passes.streak_continuity: no breaks/aliasing seen in wake at 50%; thin filaments near vortex cores ~1 px at 50% preview - re-check aliasing at full res
passes.static_vs_moving: only dye, wall highlights and faint ripple move; nothing static that should move except grain (F3)
passes.refraction: not separately quantified; streak geometry at frame 0 coincides with frame0 within streak width
